items.title: Leadership updates
items.summary: OpenAI has grown a lot. We remain focused on the same core—pursuing frontier AI research that accelerates human progress–but we now also deliver products used by hundreds of millions of people.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于公司领导层更新的常规通告，回顾了公司在追求前沿AI研究和向全球数亿用户交付产品过程中的发展历程。
